Chance for a properly oiled blade (Choji oil ritual) to fully prevent condition loss on a hit, at no cost to sharpness. Checked before the sharpness protection roll.
How many weapon hits the Choji oil protection lasts for before needing to be reapplied.

The higher the value, the longer the weapon lasts.
Sets the maximum durability of the Katana.
When enabled, Katanas, Wakizashis, crafting books, and weapon parts will spawn in additional, more mundane locations.

If this is activated, the condition protection mechanic will be applied to all bladed weapons, not just Nihonto weapons. The mechanic gives a chance to reduce sharpness instead of condition when hitting with a bladed weapon, simulating the blade getting dull but not breaking immediately.
If this is activated, the vanilla Katana will be replaced by Nihontō Katana in all vanilla spawn locations.
Multiplies how fast the blade dulls when protecting condition. 0.5: Half speed, 2.0: Double speed.
Chance to prevent condition loss at 100%% sharpness. Scaled linearly with current sharpness.

This value defines by how much the spawn rate for Nihonto Weapons and the vanilla Katana (if replaced) is changed. 0.5=halved, 1=no change, 2=double, etc. Does not affect associated literature spawns.
